principles.name: Section toolbar and title
principles.requirement: Every panel section starts with a toolbar containing a section title (with SVG icon), optional helper text, and section view controls when multiple presentation modes exist.

principles.name: Multi-mode presentation
principles.requirement: Data sections support switching presentation modes (cards, table, list, matrix, …) without a full page reload. View-switch contains presentation modes only. Standard modes are written to item_view=, never to view=.

principles.name: Create via primary Add button
principles.requirement: Preferred identities-style layout: a primary Add/create button sits to the LEFT of .item-view-switch on the same toolbar row (.section-view-toolbar). The view-switch MUST NOT include add/import/create/register as a mode. Clicking Add opens the create form and sets the section-mode param view=add|import|…. Do not keep a duplicate create mode inside the switch. Do not duplicate a leading '+' character when an SVG plus icon is already present. Legacy create-last-in-switch is superseded by this layout.

principles.name: Viewport preset and default item_view
principles.requirement: Chrome select #global-viewport writes viewport=mobile|tablet|pc. When item_view= is absent (and the user has not pinned a presentation mode), apply the preset default: tablet → cards (Panele); pc → table (Tabela); mobile → cards. Switching viewport reapplies that preset default. Afterwards item_view and viewport stay independent. Do not encode presentation in view=. view=panels remains an alias only when reading legacy URLs; write item_view=cards.

principles.name: Device-aware default view
principles.requirement: Superseded for presentation by viewport-preset-defaults. When neither viewport= nor item_view= is present, infer the viewport from width (pc >1024, tablet ≤1024, mobile ≤640) and apply the same defaults (tablet/mobile → cards, pc → table). Explicit item_view= always wins. Optional session/local pin must not override an explicit URL.

principles.name: Drawer on compact viewports, rail on PC
principles.requirement: On viewport=pc the primary workspace rail stays visible with #active-organization. On viewport=mobile and viewport=tablet the rail is hidden; a hamburger opens a drawer built from the same PANEL_NAV and the same organization select (same options, including value=__new__). The top navbar brand row must not duplicate the tenant switcher. Compact viewports use width 100% (not 100vw) and overflow-x clip; 375px must not scroll horizontally.

principles.name: Full-width section controls
principles.requirement: The Add + view-switch row (.section-view-toolbar) stretches across the section width so controls read as one bar (flex stretch), not a cramped inline-only cluster.

principles.name: Newest first
principles.requirement: Creating a resource prepends it to the collection [new, ...prev].

principles.name: Lazy loading
principles.requirement: Production collections use a unified infinite-scroll (or equivalent) footer to load further pages.

principles.name: URL state sync
principles.requirement: Panel state is shareable without full reload. Layered history: tab changes use history.pushState; chrome (viewport, item_view, lang, currency, theme, organization, menu) uses history.replaceState. Canonical section params: tab, view (create/section mode only), nested selection ids (project/host/org/…), registry, tag, filter. Canonical chrome params: viewport, item_view, lang, currency, theme, organization, last, trail, menu.

principles.name: organization tenant vs org filter
principles.requirement: organization= is the active tenant slug (membership switch). org= remains a project/collection filter under a tab. Do not reuse org= for the tenant. A shareable URL with organization= that names a membership MUST restore that tenant.

principles.name: Last actions in the URL
principles.requirement: Tab navigation records last=<previous-tab> and trail=<up to 4 prior tab ids, comma-separated, sanitized [a-z0-9-]>. Back/forward restores tab from history. Do not put secrets, tokens or PII in last/trail.

principles.name: Contextual work tabs
principles.requirement: Projects, tasks and calendar are panel tabs driven from contextual chat actions (.panel-contextual-chat-actions), not leaves of the organization rail. QUERY is read-only local context and never a mutating ticket POST. Ticket submit stays propose-only.

principles.name: Rail group overview
principles.requirement: Clicking a rail group <summary> opens a graphical group overview (topology, relations, stats, logs) at tab=group-<group-id> (e.g. group-infrastructure). It must not silently select the first leaf of that group.

principles.name: Support is not a rail registry
principles.requirement: Do not expose support as an organization-rail leaf or as a registry= enum value. tab=support and registry=support alias to the shared tasks ticket store. Client-thread sharing requires consent; do not treat support as a second ticket database.

principles.name: Org → project → artifacts
principles.requirement: When projects exist, present org filter, project list, then project detail with tickets/artifacts. IA order preference: contextual chat actions (projects/tasks/calendar) stay available on every tab; organization rail is tenants and registers only — not projects, tasks, calendar or support.

principles.name: Domain tabs vs presentation views
principles.requirement: Top-nav tab (URL tab=) identifies one content domain. Section view= is create/section mode only (add|import|list|…). Presentation is item_view= (cards|table|list|matrix|kanban|agenda|…) plus viewport=. Unrelated domains MUST NOT share one tab behind fake view modes — split into separate tabs (e.g. integrations vs mcp vs a2a) or use nested filters (registry=, tag=, filter=, org=).

principles.name: Connector registry filters
principles.requirement: MCP and A2A are separate top-level tabs (or a dedicated connectors tab with registry=mcp|a2a). Each uses presentation item_view plus tag/text filters. Register via the primary Add button (not as a view-switch domain mode). New entries prepend. Do not nest MCP/A2A inside the API integrations catalogue tab.

principles.name: System chat surface
principles.requirement: When a system chat surface exists (e.g. OpenWebUI), durable URL configuration is account/hosting + server-side injection (env / PHP window global). Browser-only localStorage is optional override, never the sole persistence. Unavailable services fail gracefully.

principles.name: One site footer
principles.requirement: Public pages and the signed-in app share one <footer class="footer"> with product line plus compare/registry/marketplace/legal/contact links. Do not keep a second footer-links or product-specific Plesk/SaaS blurb. SPA shells with id=root render the footer in the app; PHP must not inject a duplicate.

principles.name: Inline SVG icons
principles.requirement: Navigation and action icons use inline SVG components. Unicode/emoji as control icons are forbidden.

principles.name: Global item-view delegation
principles.requirement: When a global item-view selector (e.g. #global-item-view) is present, section toolbars delegate standard presentation switching (cards, table, list) to the global control and MUST NOT render redundant duplicate inline mode buttons. The global control writes item_view=, not view=.

principles.name: Workspace rail organization switcher
principles.requirement: In multi-tenant SaaS panels on viewport=pc, the primary rail navigation must expose an uncollapsed organization switcher (<select id='active-organization'>) with an inline '+ Nowa organizacja…' option. Switching organization writes organization=<slug> and establishes context on organization configuration (tab=configuration) unless the URL already names another allowed tab. Compact viewports place the same select in the drawer. The switcher must not be duplicated in the top navbar brand row.

principles.name: Generic page kind
principles.requirement: Every public or authenticated page document uses wellmanifest.gui/page/v1 and declares page.kind from the closed set landing|marketplace|article|form|auth|panel. Panel collection contracts remain wellmanifest.gui/dsl/v1 surfaces. Do not force toolbar/Add-left invariants on landing, marketplace, article, form, or auth.

principles.name: Intent kind matches observed kind
principles.requirement: When a URL or declared intent names a kind (e.g. action=contact → panel), the observed document kind MUST match. GUI-PAGE-KIND-001 is an error. Do not compare visual token drift across a kind mismatch.

principles.name: Per-kind visual budgets
principles.requirement: Observed font-family, color, and font-size counts MUST stay within page_profiles[kind].visualBudgets. Excess families, colors, or sizes are GUI-VIS-FONT-001 / GUI-VIS-COLOR-001 / GUI-VIS-TYPE-001. Budgets are defect thresholds, not a second brand SSOT — allowed tokens HOME in wellmanifest/brand + product brand.

principles.name: Heading outline
principles.requirement: Public marketing and content pages expose one H1 and a readable H2/H3 outline in page.structure.landmarks.headingOutline. Missing H1 is GUI-VIS-STRUCT-003. Missing main is GUI-VIS-STRUCT-004. kind=article without an article landmark is GUI-VIS-STRUCT-005.

principles.name: Compare kind before tokens
principles.requirement: wellmanifest.gui/page-compare/v1 sets comparable=same-kind|cross-kind|intent-mismatch. Cross-kind deltas are advisory (GUI-PAGE-KIND-002). Same-kind deltas are surface drift. Intent mismatch is not a visual-budget failure.

params.tab: Top-level panel section id, including group-<id> overview tabs
params.lang: UI language; always written, including lang=pl
params.last: Previous tab id after a user click
params.trail: Up to 4 prior tab ids, comma-separated
params.menu: open when the compact drawer is open; omit when closed
params.registry: Domain filter under a tab (organization: clients|contacts|contracts; connectors legacy: mcp|a2a when not top-level tabs). support is retired.

required_assertions: Without item_view=, viewport=tablet selects cards and viewport=pc selects table
URL writes item_view and viewport separately from view
URL writes organization (tenant) separately from org (filter)
Tab change uses push history and sets last=
viewport=mobile at 375px: no horizontal overflow, rail hidden, hamburger visible
Organization rail has no support leaf; tab=support opens tasks
One footer.class=footer on public and app chrome
Infinite-scroll footer present on production collections
